rows.en: Bah! How is the Giant Devil Project coming along?

Sir!

With the cooperation of the Iron Mask Party and Shadow, it is proceeding smoothly!

Heh heh heh… I see, then all is well!

…!?
Professor Gill! From now on, I'll be doing as I please!

Quit your yelling!!

I'm the one who will kill Kikaider! Don't you get in my way!! Understood?
Heh heh heh… You seem troubled, Professor Gill…

Installing the Devil Circuit went well enough, it seems…

But the loss of control was not part of your calculations, was it?
Mind your own business, Apfaron! Once the Giant Devil is complete, I'll have no need for Hakaider!
Quite right… But can you really trust Shadow?

…!?

What do you mean? Shadow is working with me on this Giant Devil Project…

Heh heh heh… It seems you haven't heard?

Rumor has it that Shadow's leader, Big Shadow, has hired a top-class killer… the android Waruder…

Why would Big Shadow hire Waruder? An android who specializes in assassination, no less…

Professor Gill… surely you understand the reason by now?

…!?

Could it be? Big Shadow means to assassinate me and take over my DARK!?

Heh heh heh… As expected of Professor Gill!

Big Shadow intends to take the Giant Devil into his own hands as well.
Grr, Big Shadow… I won't let this stand!!
Allow me… to take on that task.
Heh heh heh… You seem troubled, Professor Gill…

Installing the Devil Circuit went well enough, it seems…

But the loss of control was not part of your calculations, was it?

Well, well…

I haven't introduced myself yet, have I? Like Atefarina here, I am an envoy from the battle-fleet nation Naager… My name is Apfaron.

Apfaron?

Hmph… Then let me tell you something, Apfaron…

Once the Giant Devil is complete, my DARK will have no need for Hakaider!
Allow me… to take on that task…
Atefarina the Battle Princess: "Please, do leave it to us…"

Installing the Devil Circuit went well enough, it seems…

But the loss of control was not part of your calculations, was it?
Mind your own business, Atefarina! Once the Giant Devil is complete, I'll have no need for Hakaider!
Quite right… But can you really trust Shadow?

Heh heh heh… It seems you haven't heard?

Rumor has it that Shadow's leader, Big Shadow, has hired a top-class killer… the android Waruder…

Surely, yes! But why? Why would Big Shadow hire Waruder? An android who specializes in assassination, no less…

Professor Gill… surely you understand the answer by now?

…!?

Big Shadow means to assassinate me and take over my DARK!?

Heh heh heh… As expected of Professor Gill!

Big Shadow intends to take the Giant Devil into his own hands as well.
Allow me… to take on that task.
Meanwhile… the Kikaider brothers, Ichiro and Jiro, had been summoned by Bijinder, alias Mari…
Mm… I wonder what's up with Mari? Calling us out to a place like this…
Still… to think that Mari was Bijinder… That organization, Shadow, is a frightening bunch!

But… I've given Mari a Conscience Circuit, incomplete as it is!

Besides… she's no longer a member of Shadow! At least, that's what I believe!

It's true… the Conscience Circuit you gave her may be incomplete…

But…

I'm controlling my own incomplete Conscience Circuit like this, by my own will! I'm sure Mari can too…

uncertain: U08099-U08135: debug-stage CG labels; 殻 stands in for unreadable kanji (see glyph_suspects).
U08103: 殻士の殻野 read as 富士の裾野 ("Foot of Mt. Fuji").
U08108/U08109: 殻殻のプール read as 学校のプール; 教殻 as 教室. (B0101 U08043 殻殻 may also be 学校, "School".)
U08120: 殻日 read as 夕日 ("Sunset"); could be 朝日.
U08123: 赤い殻（カイコウ） unclear; guessed 赤い繭 ("Red Cocoon").
U08164: narration-kind row carries the speaker name inline (闘姫・アテファリナ/「…」); rendered as "Atefarina the Battle Princess: \"…\"".
U08169: そのまさかです rendered "Surely, yes!" answering Gill's 'Surely not…'; awkward, could be "It's exactly that!".
U08174: イチロー兄さん rendered "Ichiro" (Jiro to his elder brother); "big brother" dropped.
U08177: マリさん referred to as "she".

new_names.why: from glossary ジャイアントデビル
